_note: The six scenarios of six_scenarios_v63_mixture.json, unchanged and byte-for-byte, plus scenario_7_full_pipeline_acc: the combined-likelihood recommendation of /eos/project-e/ep-nu/evilla/sn-online-pointing/pipeline-dev/combo_study/combo_study.md section 8.3. Scenario 3 is kept in the catalog as the unchanged regression reference (same table, same selection, same emcee fit as the v63 '_matchfix' campaign). Scenario 7 is the mixture-ct path with (a) a HARD CT v80 >= 0.50 cut (mixture.ct_hard_cut; a hard cut and mixture.s_min with p_floor 0 give the same posterior, the cut only keeps n_selected and the cost honest), (b) E > 5 MeV, (c) per-event p_i = P(ES|CT score) from the slice calibration with pi_mode 'fixed', pi_fixed 0.068421, (d) the burst-axis ES table of the t=0.50 selection, (e) a FLAT CC component -- the detector-frame CC map is NOT needed, it cancels exactly in the consistent common-acceptance model (combo_study.md section 3.1) -- and (f) the NEW key 'acceptance_path': 49 real-SH coefficients of the detector-frame reco-direction acceptance R(d), adding -sum_i log Z_i(n) with Z_i(n) = sum_{l<=6} lambda_l^(i) R_l(n). grid_n 12000 is the grid of the study's recommended arm CMB2_t050_accCC_ccl6 (grid size is immaterial: 41253 moves theta68 by <0.05 deg, combo_study.md section 2.1), so the pipeline numbers are directly comparable with the offline ones. REBUILD RULE: the acceptance coefficients, the ES table and the P(ES|score) calibration are properties of the ED model, the CT model and the selection, not of the physics -- rebuild all three together and re-run the rotated-R null whenever any of them changes.
